Test Description: Verify Login button is present and enabled by default

Test Description: Verify error is shown for invalid password with valid username

2. Enter valid username
3. Enter wrong password
4. Click Login button

Test Description: Verify client-side validation triggers when username is empty

4. Click Login button

Test Description: Verify client-side validation triggers when password is empty

2. Enter valid username

4. Click Login button

Test Description: Verify validation errors for both fields when form submitted empty
Test Steps:

Test Description: Verify show/hide password toggle changes input type

4. Click again to hide

Test Description: Verify button shows loading state and is disabled during API call
Preconditions: Valid user exists; network throttling applied

1. Open /login
2. Enter valid credentials
3. Click Login and immediately observe button
Expected Result: Button is disabled and shows 'Signing in...' text while request is in progress

Test Description: Verify error message does not reveal which field (username or password) is wrong
Test Steps:

2. Enter wrong credentials
3. Click Login

Test Description: Verify auth token is stored in sessionStorage on successful login

Test Description: Verify login is locked/rate-limited after N consecutive failed attempts
Preconditions: Login page is loaded; valid user account exists
Test Steps:
1. Attempt login with wrong password N times (N = configured limit, e.g., 5)
2. Note response after last attempt
Test Data:
Username: testuser
Password: WrongPass (repeated N times)
Expected Result: User sees lockout/rate-limit message or receives HTTP 429; further attempts rejected for configured duration
